name: To Do
description: Today's tasks with repeats, streaks and a calm progress bar. Right-click a task to mark it important, number your plan or move it to tomorrow. Keys: N add, arrows select, Space done, F2 or E edit, I, O, T, Del. Everything stays on your PC.
author: AmineChr54

dayStart.label: New day starts at (hour)
dayStart.hint: Night owl? Set 4 and tasks done at 1 am still count for the day before.

clearCompleted.label: Clear finished one-off tasks the next day
